featured_reviews.name: Mohammed Jumboo
featured_reviews.review_text: The worst experience of buying a second hand car of my life. This was my first car, a hyundai i10 sports which I bought from a sweet talking uncle who is also  one of the owners of OM motors. I read the reviews of OM motors which as per the review is excellent online, I purchased a car which was a 2013 I10 Hyundai sports. While taking the test drive, the car did not start initially, the uncle said beta that's because of the battery, I will change it for you, I got the car at 3.50lakhs. he provided me with previous servicing papers and 6 months warranty for the car in case of any issues. After a week of the  car being with me, it started giving me starting problems, it would not start, I changed the battery to a new battery as I was given the same old battery. Again I had starting issues. I went to the showroom for a thorough check up of the car and I was advised it was a flooded car i.e. it had been in flood water and because of it you are having this problem. I called the uncle and said about the issues, he as a smooth talker told me beta I have been just operated upon and now that you bought the car which will stay with you for a long time why not do the repair work ,so I asked about the six month warranty and he bluntly said I can't do anything about it since when you took the car it was fine and does not count into the warranty. I was stunned and felt miserable. I have spent 50000 on the car to repair the problem. My problem is that the trust once broken will always stay broken. I will never recommend buying a second hand car from OM motors ever to anyone. If you still want to buy it , then please ensure to get a experienced mechanic along so that you don't get cheated like I was. Because blindly trusted whatever I was told about the car. I just regret this whole experience. I wish it would never had happened. I am have added the picture of the cars with the number plate depicting that I bought it from OM motors to verify the authenticity of this post. I am a genuine customer who does not wish for someone else to go through what I went through and thus I am providing a detailed description.

I recently purchased a secondhand Suzuki Access 125 (2020 model) from Ambika Motors, and the overall experience was excellent. The guidance and support from their team was very clear and transparent, which made the entire purchase process smooth and stressfree.

featured_reviews.name: Rudra Tank
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hello guys, if you are reading this please note that, this guy is complete scam as per my experience. He will act very nicely till you purchase and make the payment, after that he would even consider your issue. He has the habit of distracting and deviating from the main point, he won't let you speak and will keep changing the topic. Had bought a 2nd hand bike, and there was issue with mileage, the bike was hardly giving 30 -35 km/per litre average. Went to him with the issue, and he did not consider my request. He already knew that the bike was not giving mileage still he just repaired modified and sold the bike. I had a loss of around 5k to 6k for trying to repair and at the end had to again purchase a new activa because of the constant problems of the bike.
Complete scammer. He knew there was issue and still he sold the bike, and I got to know that bike was not giving average after few days, you'll know the issue of mileage only after riding it for 2 3 days.
Before buying anything from this guy, take your mechanic with you and have the bike checked or make a demand of returning the vehicle within 7 days or else you'll lose money just like I did. Don't fall into his sweet talk.

featured_reviews.name: Sandesh Kulaye
featured_reviews.review_text: I purchased a Honda Activa from Ambika Motors Borivali and had a good experience. The staff was supportive and guided me through the process smoothly. Delivery was on time, paperwork was handled properly, and the overall buying experience was satisfactory. Happy with my purchase and would recommend Ambika Motors for two-wheeler buyers.

featured_reviews.name: Swapnil Varute
